description: The repository that holds this record associates the subject DID as its requester or bidder. Record key: <service>-<subject with : replaced by ->.

subject.description: The associated requester or bidder repository DID.

service.description: The role the subject is associated for.

contract.description: The market.accept of the contract this association is scoped to; requires expiresAt.

expiresAt.description: The association is invalid after this time.

parent.description: The association that associates this record's repository, for chains.
